title: Easy steps to use Claude
description:
Comment “COWORK” if you want a step by step video on how to use this inside your business and I’ll send it to you 📩

Most people open Claude and go straight to the chat window. That’s the wrong move.

Cowork is where you connect your tools — Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Slack — and let Claude handle the actual work.

Tell it to go through your inbox, find every email asking about pricing, and draft a reply to each one.
It reads forty emails, writes forty replies, and lines them up for your approval before anything sends.

You can even give it your templates so every proposal is written exactly how you want it — without you typing a word.

This is how to use AI to manage email, automate your inbox, and actually get your time back.

#claude #aiautomation #anthropic #ai #aitools
